title: Superexponential lower bounds for multicolor triangle Ramsey numbers
abstract: Resolves Erdős problem 183 by proving that the k-color triangle Ramsey number has a k-th root tending to infinity. The development constructs saturated palette families and recursive edge colorings, derives an explicit superexponential lower bound, and proves matching order-of-growth bounds for the logarithm of the Ramsey number.

The k-th root of the k-color triangle Ramsey number tends to infinity, resolving Erdős problem 183.
For every k at least two, the k-color triangle Ramsey number is at least ((k^(1/3))/(6 exp(38) log k))^k, and its k-th root tends to infinity.
The logarithm of the k-color triangle Ramsey number has order k log k.
